chunks: On the day the great calamity befalls, and they are called to bow in homage, they will not be able to do so.
ai.seo_question: What does 'uncovering the thigh' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'uncovering the thigh' (kashf an-saq) is interpreted as a sign of divine majesty and the removal of veils, often linked to the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt or the manifestation of God's power. The inability to prostrate reflects the spiritual rigidity of the arrogant, who, despite being commanded, find their joints locked due to their worldly pride, fulfilling the divine decree of their fate.
